contentText: Nadia Massih is pleased to welcome Dr. Wouter Dewulf, professor at the University of Antwerp AMS where he serves as Academic Director for the Master of Maritime/Air Transport Management. According to Dr. Dewulf, the current crisis facing global airlines must be understood as a convergence of geopolitical upheaval and unstable markets. The sharp rise in oil prices, driven by war, has immediately had a dramatic effect on the airline industry. All the while, airspace instability and shifting travel patterns have produced an asymmetric impact across regions.
